description: This file contains template implementations for safe integer arithmetic operations, including addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, modulus, negation, and absolute value, with range checking and overflow detection. It also defines classes for managing numeric state and validity, supporting both integer and floating-point types, and includes promotion and safety checks for arithmetic operations.

classes.name: CheckedNumericState
classes.description: Template class managing the state and validity of numeric values, specialized for integer and floating-point types.

methods.name: CheckedAdd
methods.description: Performs checked addition with overflow detection, setting validity status.

methods.name: CheckedSub
methods.description: Performs checked subtraction with overflow detection, setting validity status.

methods.name: CheckedMul
methods.description: Performs checked multiplication with overflow detection, supporting different type sizes.

methods.name: CheckedDiv
methods.description: Performs checked division, detecting division overflow on signed min/-1.

methods.name: CheckedMod
methods.description: Performs checked modulus operation with validity checks.

methods.name: CheckedNeg
methods.description: Performs checked negation, detecting overflow on signed min.

methods.name: CheckedAbs
methods.description: Performs checked absolute value, detecting overflow on signed min.

methods.name: CheckedUnsignedAbs
methods.description: Returns unsigned absolute value, supporting both signed and unsigned types.
